in_sanskrit.name: Mallu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mallu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Mallu is derived from the Marathi language. It is a diminutive form of the name Mallika, which means 'queen'. The name Mallu is used to denote a young girl or a little one.

in_hindi.name: मळ्लू
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who understands and comforts (the suffering)

in_marathi.name: Mallu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mallu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Mallu is derived from the Marathi language. It is a diminutive form of the name Mallika, which means 'queen'. The name Mallu is used to denote a young girl or a little one.
